Build a named format vector from a coded column

Source: R/code_to_fmt.r
ks_code_to_fmt.Rd

Reads a column that contains "code=label" entries, splits them on =, and passes the resulting lookup to ksformat::fnew() as a numeric format.

Usage

ks_code_to_fmt(dt, col, name = NULL)

Arguments

dt

A data frame containing the coded column.

col

<tidy-select> Bare name of the column with "code=label" values.

name

Character scalar. Name to register the format under via ksformat::fnew(). Defaults to "<dt_name>_<col_name>_fmt".

Value

Invisibly returns the result of ksformat::fnew() (called for its side-effect of registering the format).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# dt has a column DECODE with entries like "1=Male", "2=Female"
ks_code_to_fmt(dm, DECODE)
} # }
